At CesiumAstro
, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

The Skylark product line is focused on the rapid design, build, and test of cutting-edge active phased array antennas (AESA) for terrestrial and airborne applications. Current programs span high-power, large-scale ground terminals for missile defense to commercial airline and helicopter connectivity solutions.

We are looking to add a Senior Program Manager
to our team. In this role you will serve as a key program management advisor, advancing successful program execution through strategic planning, customer engagement, and cross-functional leadership. This role strengthens organizational performance by leading complex, high-value programs, evaluating program risks, and implementing execution strategies that achieve customer commitments while supporting long-term business objectives.

Working cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Management, Business Development, and customers, the Senior Program Manager supports strategic program execution, customer relationship management, risk mitigation, and operational performance while ensuring programs are delivered in accordance with contractual requirements, financial objectives, and customer expectations.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Lead execution of complex, high-value programs by developing integrated program strategies, execution plans, schedules, milestones, and performance objectives.
Evaluate program performance across cost, schedule, technical, quality, and contractual requirements while implementing strategies that improve execution and customer satisfaction.
Oversee successful execution of product development, manufacturing, production, integration, and customer delivery activities.
Provide strategic direction that ensures alignment between program objectives and organizational priorities.
Serve as the primary customer interface for complex programs and strategic customer engagements.
Lead customer program reviews, executive briefings, milestone reviews, and contractual discussions.
Build long-term relationships with customers that strengthen confidence, program execution, and future business opportunities.
Communicate program performance, risks, financial status, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and customers.
Lead integrated program teams across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Management, and Business Development.
Evaluate program risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and business impacts while implementing mitigation strategies.
Coordinate proposal transition, contract execution, production readiness, product delivery, and lifecycle support activities.
Influence cross-functional decision-making to achieve successful program outcomes.
Spearhead initiatives that strengthen program management processes, execution methodologies, and operational effectiveness.
Develop integrated program management frameworks, reporting tools, governance processes, and performance metrics.
Support continuous improvement initiatives that improve program execution, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, company procedures, and customer expectations.

Job Requirements And Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Program Management, Operations Management, Supply Chain, or a related field with 12–15 years of related experience, or a Master's degree with 8–12 years of related experience in program management, project management, operations, engineering, manufacturing, or a related discipline.
Extensive knowledge of program management, customer relationship management, integrated product development, and operational execution.
Expertise in program lifecycle management, strategic planning, financial management, risk management, contract execution, and cross-functional leadership.
Proficiency in utilizing program management tools, ERP systems, business reporting applications, and program performance metrics.
Applies strategic thinking when balancing customer objectives, contractual commitments, business priorities, and program execution.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to lead multiple complex programs and strategic organizational priorities.
Effective communication, influencing, and collaboration skills with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Management, Business Development, executive leadership, and customers.
Attention to detail when managing contractual performance, financial objectives, integrated schedules, customer communications, and program documentation.
Demonstrates commercial insight by balancing customer success, program performance, financial objectives, and long-term business growth.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, e.g. Oracle, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or equivalent platforms.
Program and project management applications, e.g. Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Primavera, or equivalent applications.
Business intelligence and reporting tools, e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent applications.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction To The Team

InsurTech is Expedia Group’s team for insurance and assurance products
. It identifies, incubates, and scales products that drive revenue and fit into the traveler journey, and it owns the end-to-end technology strategy and execution for those products.

In practice, the team builds reusable shop/book/serve capabilities for insurance and fintech offerings across Expedia brands, and focuses on things like supply integration, checkout, servicing, claims, content, experimentation, and ML/data platforms.

In This Role, You Will

Lead the definition, planning, and delivery of complex, multi-team technical programs across the Insurtech organization, with a focus on Insurance and embedded flexibility products, ensuring clear problem framing, measurable outcomes, and alignment to Expedia Group’s strategic objectives.
Drive innovative programs that improve the traveler experience while delivering significant impact to a P&L business within Expedia Group, translating strategy into executable roadmaps, operating plans, and measurable business and customer outcomes.
Drive end-to-end program execution by establishing program structures, roadmaps, and success metrics; proactively identifying cross-team dependencies; and resolving risks and issues to maintain predictable delivery across engineering, product, business, and partner stakeholders.
Partner closely with engineering and architecture leaders to shape technical solutions, including system design, API contracts, and data flows, and ensure design decisions support scalability, resilience, security, and long-term maintainability.
Collaborate with supplier partners and cross-functional teams across global markets to deliver customer and commercial value at scale, align priorities, and accelerate execution across a distributed ecosystem.
Create and operate effective governance and communication mechanisms, including steering forums, technical reviews, and decision logs, that provide transparency, enable timely trade-offs, and keep executives, partner organizations, and stakeholders informed and engaged.
Drive breakthrough and 0-to-1 product development outcomes by enabling experimentation, validating new opportunities, and helping teams turn emerging concepts into scalable products and platform capabilities.
Champion and implement best practices in technical program management at scale, including standardized planning, execution, and operational excellence practices, while mentoring other TPMs and influencing how programs are run across the broader organization.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes by coordinating experimentation, rollout, and monitoring plans, and ensuring teams have the practices and controls needed to use AI-driven systems, tools, and workflows responsibly and effectively.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience leading complex technology initiatives.
Extensive experience (typically 10+ years) in technical program management, software engineering, or a closely related discipline, including ownership of large, cross-team, or multi-service programs in a technology organization.
Proven ability to work hands-on with engineering teams on technical topics such as distributed system design, API design, data modeling, and integration patterns, and to translate technical details into clear, outcome-focused plans.
Demonstrated success driving programs from concept through launch and ongoing iteration, including definition of measurable objectives, risk and dependency management, and establishing mechanisms for tracking and reporting progress at scale.
Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including partnering with engineering and data teams to ensure such capabilities are integrated and operated safely and effectively within program scope.

Preferred Qualifications

Track record of leading multi-quarter, multi-team technical transformations, platform initiatives, or 0-to-1 product programs, operating at organization or domain scale and navigating complex stakeholder landscapes across product, engineering, and business teams.
Experience delivering in highly regulated product environments, with the ability to incorporate compliance, risk, privacy, security, and operational control requirements into program planning, execution, and decision-making.
Strong experience with B2C program and product development, including delivering customer-facing capabilities that improve user experience, drive adoption, and balance customer value with measurable business outcomes.
Deep experience influencing technical direction through program work, including coordinating architectural reviews, driving alignment on system and API design decisions, and ensuring data models and integration approaches enable long-term extensibility, reuse, and partner interoperability.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with external partners, suppliers, and third-party providers, aligning joint roadmaps, managing dependencies, and delivering shared outcomes across internal and external teams.
Demonstrated ability to design and improve program operating models and execution frameworks, including mechanisms that enhance reliability, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement for large-scale, customer-facing systems.
Strong data-driven decision-making skills, including defining and instrumenting key technical and business metrics, using data to assess program health and trade-offs, and adjusting plans based on empirical evidence, experimentation results, and evolving market or partner inputs.
Safely integrates and operates AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, with experience steering AI/ML-related programs such as personalization, automation, or decision-support capabilities, including responsible use guardrails, evaluation methods, and collaboration with specialized AI/ML teams.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager – Server Hardware Engineering, AWS Mainstream Compute
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Hardware Engineering Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

In this org: Amazon Web Services (AWS) Scaled Compute is a fast growing and leading-edge research and development team that creates enterprise compute and storage server designs for our innovative web service and e-commerce technology platforms. Our designs are industry-leading in terms of performance, frugality and operational excellence, and are critical to the success of the AWS business and the hundreds of thousands of customers who use utility computing today. We are seeking an experienced Sr. Technical Program Manager (TPM) to define and build the next generation of our cloud platforms. Our success depends on our world-class server infrastructure; we’re handling massive scale and rapid integration of emergent technologies.

The ideal TPM candidate will be an experienced program manager who is skilled in managing server hardware product development teams across several geographic regions using a variety of suppliers (CM, ODM/IHV). The successful candidate will be an innovative self-starter and leader. The candidate will be familiar with the cloud computing industry and AWS offerings and will be passionate about providing the best possible customer experience at the best cost. The candidate will have an obsession with data and precise analysis and will use these as inputs to make decisions.

Key job responsibilities

As a TPM on the Server Hardware Engineering team you will be responsible for leading multiple simultaneous hardware product development programs in a highly cross-functional environment which includes internal customers, external vendors and technology partners. You’ll provide leadership in the application of new technologies to large scale server deployments in a continuous effort to deliver a world-class customer experience at a world-class cost point. This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you’ll work with thought leaders in multiple technology areas. You’ll have high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you’ll be constantly looking for ways to improve your product’s performance, quality and cost. Using data and key metrics, you will also drive and measure process improvements that enhance our operational effectiveness. You will work independently in a dynamic, challenging, and fast-changing organization. We’re changing an industry, and we need individuals who are ready for this challenge and who want to reach beyond what is possible today.

A day in the life

You will have exposure to teams and leaders across the entire company. You will be a part of a leading edge research and development team. You will see many aspects of the Amazon business. You will have a direct impact on our bottom line and the ability to improve things for our developers. You will be part of a growing, fast paced, and fun team. You will have ownership and responsibility for defining and executing processes that deliver both savings and productivity for Amazon.

About The Team

The team you will report to consists of a diverse set of skills across many technical disciplines including TPM, Hardware engineering, software development, and hardware systems design. We are committed to delivering innovated solutions to our customers through the full life cycle of delivering and operating AWS hardware.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
Experience working cross-functionally with electrical, mechanical, firmware and software and driving decision making among stakeholders with competing goals
Strong technical and problem solving skills
Confident leader who can prioritize and analyze trade-offs, communicate clearly and compellingly and effectively influence internally and externally, across organization boundaries. Able to independently influence and resolve conflicts with others
Experienced in gathering requirements and developing server hardware specifications
Ability to apply critical thinking in complex situations; experience working in cross functional groups including mechanical Engineering, test, reliability, failure analysis.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, AI Agents
jobs.description:
About Newxel
Newxel offers talent solutions geared toward filling engineering positions in the way that best suits the client; this can involve hiring specialists directly into the client's team, sourcing engineers through our European hubs, or providing Employer of Record services. This applies whether the requirement is for one position or for an entire R&D centre complete with dedicated labs.
We have sold our services for nine years, achieving around $20M in revenue and operating six legal entities, with clients including Check Point, HiBob, and Renesas. Our platform can evaluate more than 1,000 candidates in less than 10 minutes, and we handle engineer recruitment and hiring ourselves.
Our agent platform, built on Google Cloud, currently hosts the business agents used in production—including candidate sourcing, CV generation, vacancy creation, policy control, and the Copilot our teams use in Slack. The next stage is to turn the platform into a product by offering client-facing services and providing agent integration for other companies.

Why this role exists
Our business already runs on AI agents. We designed each one through a long conversation with our CEO, and that doesn't scale. We need agents for every function of the company, and next for our clients.

We are hiring the person who turns business needs into agents that work at a steady pace. You find out how a process really works, design the agent, get it built, get it accepted by the business, and build the team and the process that make this repeatable. This is more of a builder's mandate than a caretaker's, and the person we are looking for should recognise the difference.

What you will own
The agent portfolio.
Every agent we run or plan, with its business owner, state and plan. Today: candidate sourcing, vacancy creation, sales signal monitoring and other sales agents, quoting, and the intake agent for our client-facing service.
Discovery and agent specifications.
You go to the people who own and validate a process, find out how it works today with real examples, and describe how it should work. You design the agent at architecture level: which steps are code, which need a model, where a person confirms, what is kept in memory, what a run should cost. You write the specification an agent is built from without further back-and-forth, and you organise its acceptance by the business.
The agent factory.
The process that takes a request to an agent in production and keeps it working: intake, specification, technical review with our Tech Lead, build, testing, business acceptance, release, monitoring. Templates, standards and measures for all of it. You define the profile of the people who build agents, hire them with Recruitment Operations, and lead them.
The R&D delivery plan.
One plan across the platform (from the Tech Lead), the client-facing product (from our product scope map) and the agent portfolio, with people, dates and money, at quarterly, monthly and weekly resolution. You decide with the CEO what ships, what waits and what gets cut.
Rhythm.
One board, a cadence that serves shipping without ceremony, and a short written report to the CEO every week.
Single point of contact.
Every request for new agents or R&D work from sales, recruitment, marketing and operations comes through you. Production incidents go to the Tech Lead.

How you work with the CEO
The CEO drives product and technical vision at high velocity. You absorb that direction, ask the sharp questions early, translate ambition into plans the team can execute, and manage change on the ground when priorities shift.

What we are looking for
Must have:
5+ years in project or program management in software teams, with at least 1.5 years in LLM agents, AI automation, or ML.
You have designed LLM agents or AI automations at the architecture level yourself. You can read an agent's graph and a run trace and explain why a run cost what it did.
Proven process discovery: you have mapped processes with the people who run them and written specifications that engineers built from without rework. Bring an example.
You have built a delivery function or process from zero and hired people into it.
You have worked with business stakeholders outside tech (sales, operations, recruitment) and closely with a technical founder, including shifting priorities without losing the team.
Fluent English, written and spoken.

Strong plus:
an earlier career as a software engineer; recruitment, staffing or operations as a domain; work at an AI automation agency or consultancy that builds agents for clients.
Please include an example of a process map or specification you wrote, anonymised or created for this application. Do not send your employer's confidential documents.

What we offer
A company whose business already runs on AI agents, and the mandate to build the factory that makes them. Direct work with the CEO and with the people who own the processes. The mandate to hire and lead your own team of agent builders. A competitive base salary based on your experience, and an annual bonus of up to 15% of base, tied to the agent factory's goals.
How we work
Direct communication, written decisions, ownership. When something is unclear, we expect a proposal with a rationale, not a list of open questions. Our team works across Europe.

Process
Screening with our technical recruiter (recorded with your consent) · interviews with our Head of Recruitment Operations and our CMO · a written case · final interview with the CEO · two reference checks.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

About The Role

Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists
— engagement leaders who serve as the operational backbone, program lead, and business strategist for high-stakes customer migrations and platform modernizations. Operating in an AI-native delivery framework, you own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for fast-paced, high-impact engagements (typically 12 weeks or less) that transition enterprise customers to modern platforms like MC Next, Revenue Cloud, Tableau, and Data Cloud.

You're a hybrid of Program Manager, Engagement Lead, and Business Analyst. Rather than managing a schedule from the sidelines, you lead engagement strategy, direct cross-functional delivery pods, run executive governance, and use modern AI tools to accelerate discovery and execution — keeping complex migrations on track and ensuring enterprise customers see value fast.

What You'll Be Doing

Own engagement success end-to-end as the single point of accountability across the full lifecycle: Discovery → Migration Strategy → Execution Oversight → Value Realization & Handoff
Establish engagement governance, track critical-path milestones, manage scope, and proactively resolve delivery risks
Direct the day-to-day rhythm of cross-functional teams, including internal Migration Leads, Professional Services consultants, and SI Partners — keeping them unblocked and aligned on scope and delivery dates
Serve as the primary trusted contact for VP- and C-suite customer stakeholders, translating complex migration workstreams into clear business outcomes
Lead steering committee reviews and help customers navigate organizational change
Personally lead discovery workshops and "Jobs-to-be-Done" reviews, auditing legacy business processes and mapping requirements to standardized target platform patterns
Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and automation agents) to synthesize legacy documentation, extract business logic, auto-generate project assets, and accelerate delivery workflows
Assess customer organizational readiness, define change enablement paths, and lead operational handoffs post-migration to support lasting adoption

Required Qualifications

8+ years leading enterprise customer delivery, technical program management (TPM), engagement management, or management consulting for enterprise SaaS transitions
Proven track record owning enterprise engagement scopes, managing cross-functional delivery teams, and running tight, time-bound client engagements with strict milestone discipline
Strong background in program governance, scope management, business process analysis, and executive stakeholder management
Experience orchestrating delivery alongside Professional Services teams, System Integrators (SIs), and external customer teams
Broad working understanding of enterprise cloud platforms across Marketing, Revenue/CPQ, Analytics, or Data Cloud ecosystems (MC Next, Revenue Cloud, Tableau, or Data Cloud)
Practical experience using AI productivity tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate program analysis, documentation, and operational efficiency
Willingness to travel up to 25% to customer sites as needed
Degree or equivalent relevant experience required.

Prior experience in a Success Architect, Solution Architect, or similar customer-facing delivery role at an enterprise software company
Familiarity with Salesforce's platform ecosystem and migration methodologies
Experience building or refining AI-accelerated delivery playbooks

You'll operate at the center of Salesforce's highest-stakes customer migrations, with direct influence on how enterprises modernize their platforms. You'll work alongside Professional Services, SI partners, and product teams while pushing the boundaries of AI-native delivery.

Join an innovative team that delivers tailored intelligence products and services to protect our customers and business operations. In this role, you will produce rapid risk assessments, conduct open-source intelligence (OSINT) investigations, and translate complex customer requirements into scalable, actionable solutions. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that demands critical thinking, deep-dive analysis, and the ability to manage competing priorities with exceptional attention to detail. They bring a genuine passion for delighting customers, collaborating across teams, and continuously raising the bar - always seeking opportunities to refine processes, close gaps, and deliver more impactful products.

Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data with a strong understanding and application of analytical techniques.
Proactively identify and analyze relevant threats and trends and produce written strategic analysis, oral briefs, and tactical/investigative assessments in a cohesive and concise format to serve customers across business lines.
Engage with internal customers to understand their priorities and translate the requirements into solutions.
Identify new solutions, methodologies, including using AI, to help improve information collection and reporting. Including the creation of maps or other visuals and tools to support the team's deliverables.

Diverse Experiences

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Can show strong verbal and written communication skills
Experience handling confidential information
Experience with open source investigation techniques
Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail

jobs.title: OPEN-SOURCE INTELLIGENCE ANALYST (CYBER)
jobs.description:
Overview

Quantum Research International, Inc. (Quantum
) provides our national defense and federal civilian and industry customers with services and products in the following main areas: 1) Cybersecurity and Information Operations; 2) Space Operations and Control; 3) Aviation Systems; 4) Ground, Air and Missile Defense, and Fires Support Systems; 5) Intelligence Programs Support; 6) Experimentation and Test; 7) Program Management; and (8) Audio/Visual Technology Applications. Quantum's Corporate Office is located in Huntsville, AL, but Quantum actively hires for positions nationwide and internationally. We pride ourselves on providing high quality support to the U.S. Government and our Nation's Warfighters. In addition to our corporate office, we have physical locations in; Colorado Springs, CO; Crestview FL; and Tupelo, MS

Mission

Quantum Research Intl. is seeking a motivated mission-focused Open-Source Intelligence Analyst
to support Department of War customers through the research, analysis, and reporting of publicly available information. The ideal candidate is a cleared analyst who can conduct open-source research, identify relevant patterns and risks, and turn large amounts of public data into clear, actionable insights for operational and senior-level stakeholders.

This role supports Army and DoD missions by helping customers understand what can be learned from open sources, public records, social media, technical information, geospatial data, news reporting, government documents, commercial data, and other publicly accessible information. The role also includes cyber threat research support, including analysis of adversary tradecraft, vulnerability context, cyber infrastructure indicators, and publicly available exploit or tool information to support risk awareness and mission planning.

Responsibilities

Conduct open-source research using publicly available information, commercial data, social media, public records, government databases, news media, forums, and technical sources
Evaluate, correlate, and synthesize information from multiple open sources to answer customer requirements
Identify trends, patterns, relationships, vulnerabilities, and indicators relevant to Army, DoW, and Defense Industrial Base missions
Analyze adversary cyber tactics, techniques, procedures, infrastructure, tooling, and publicly available vulnerability information to support mission planning and risk awareness
Analyze foreign and domestic publicly available information to support operational risk, threat awareness, and decision-making
Use structured analytic methods to evaluate source reliability, information credibility, intelligence gaps, and confidence levels
Support geospatial, technical, cyber, RF/EW, supply chain, or operational research efforts when relevant to customer requirements
Develop written assessments, briefings, dashboards, and visual products that communicate findings clearly and professionally
Prepare and deliver concise briefings to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leaders and government customers
Develop and maintain analytic templates, research workflows, source lists, standard operating procedures, and reporting formats
Other duties as assigned as they pertain to the scope of mission and business contract requirements

Requirements

Active Top Secret clearance, or Secret clearance with ability to obtain Top Secret.
Candidates must be able to maintain eligibility for access to classified information
AS/BS degree is preferred or 3 years experience in lieu of degree
Experience conducting open-source research, publicly available information analysis, all-source intelligence analysis, investigations, cyber threat intelligence, or related national security analysis
Familiarity with cyber threat actors, vulnerability research, adversary infrastructure, exploit trends, or offensive cyber concepts
Strong ability to gather, organize, validate, and analyze information from diverse public sources
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing reports, briefings, executive summaries, or intelligence products
Ability to work in a fast-paced mission environment with changing priorities, short timelines, and multiple stakeholders

Desired Skills And Qualificatons

Curious, detail-oriented, and persistent in finding information across open sources.

Data Analyst

Overall Ambition

Nando’s is on a journey to Create Lasting Happiness, making a difference to the lives of our people, our customers, and the communities we work in. Originally started in Johannesburg, South Africa, we pride ourselves on creating memorable experiences for everyone involved in Nando’s: from our employees, communities, founders, and suppliers, but most importantly, our customers.

Whilst we always look back on our history and story with pride, the story is still evolving. We have recently been growing our digital capabilities to ensure the Nando’s experience remains relevant to modern-day customers.

You will be joining a tech team that has grown rapidly in the past five years and is determined to enable change within the restaurant industry by bringing innovative thinking and the latest technology tools and practices to solve some of its most complex problems.

The Data and Analysis Team

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data and Analysis team. Our remit is to ensure everyone has access to the right information, at the right time, and that Nando’s gets the best value out of our data to achieve our business goals.

Our current focus is extracting insights from the data and creating a single source of accurate, timely data as we continue to increase our data maturity and advance our predictive analytic capability and explore the role of AI in the business.

You will be part of our work to support our strategic goals and build a data-informed attitude for addressing our opportunities and challenges.

Our Values

At Nando’s, our values guide how we work, make decisions, and show up for each other every day:

Pride – We take pride in everything we do, from the quality of our food to the impact of our work.
Passion – We bring energy, enthusiasm, and a love for what we do.
Courage – We speak up, challenge the status quo, and are not afraid to try new things.
Integrity – We do the right thing, act honestly, and build trust with each other.
Family – We care for and support one another, creating a sense of belonging where everyone can thrive.

What We're Looking For

As a Data Analyst you will work across a wide range of domains from financial and operational data, to kitchen tech and stock, helping our teams make better decisions grounded in sound analysis. As a curious problem-solver, you will be able to move between the technical and the commercial; and be comfortable building data models as well as presenting findings to senior stakeholders.

In this role you’ll work independently across the full data stack, understanding the ‘why’ behind requests before jumping to the ‘what’, and contributing to the translation of business problems into well-defined, actionable work. You’ll be supported by a collaborative team and won’t be expected to deliver everything solo from day one, but you’ll be expected to grow into doing so.

You will…

Write and maintain SQL models (in Dataform) to transform and serve reliable data across our pipelines
Support data engineers in the design, building and testing of data pipelines, able to contribute meaningfully, not just consume the output
Build and iterate on cloud-based reports and dashboards in Looker (or similar BI tool), giving our support teams and restaurants clear, actionable insight into performance
Translate business questions into well-scoped analysis and understand the problem and domain before reaching for the answer
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, choosing the right medium for the audience
Peer review colleagues’ work and contribute to data quality standards and documentation
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and data tasks, and take the initiative to implement them

Skills Required

You will have proven experience in the following:

Writing complex SQL to query, transform and model data across our cloud data platform (window functions, CTEs, complex datatypes)
Building and maintaining data models in Dataform, or a similar data transformation tool such as Snowflake or DBT, with an understanding of how they fit into the broader pipeline
Building reports and dashboards in Looker or a similar BI tool, serving reliable, self-serve data to the business
Using Git as standard practice — branching, pull requests and code review
Contributing to the translation of business requests into clearly scoped, actionable work items
Applying data quality techniques — writing tests, identifying issues proactively and communicating data limitations clearly
Documenting data models, definitions and lineage to a production standard
Understanding data governance principles and championing good data management practice within the team
Applying and understanding when to use relevant statistical methods to support analysis
Supporting data engineers in designing, coding and testing data processing pipelines
Using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Claude) to improve the speed and quality of your work — critically, not blindly — with an awareness of responsible AI use and data governance implications

You will also display

Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, able to explain complex findings in plain language and tell the story behind the data
Genuine intellectual curiosity, actively exploring new tools and methods, including AI, and sharing what you learn with the team
Comfort with ambiguity, able to define the right question and find the “so what” before jumping to answer
A product mindset, understanding the business objective behind every piece of analysis, not just the request on the surface
A proactive approach to improving processes, data quality and ways of working, with the initiative to make it happen, not just flag it
A collaborative team attitude, peer reviewing others’ work, sharing knowledge and contributing to a stronger team

Inclusion

At Nando’s, everyone is welcome. Inspired by our Southern African heritage we know and value the richness that diversity brings to Nando’s. We’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful culture for all; including our existing and future Nandocas, partners and suppliers, customers and the communities we are a part of. We deliberately work hard to create an environment where every individual is valued, respected and can flourish regardless of who they are, their background or outlook on life.

We welcome applications from a diverse range of individuals and will consider any reasonable adjustments in order to enable candidates to perform as well as possible during the recruitment process.

Description

Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent unauthorized activity among hundreds of millions of eCommerce transactions across the globe? What would you do to increase trust in an online marketplace where millions of buyers create and sign in to shop at Amazon? How would you build systems that evolve over time to proactively identify and neutralize new and emerging MO?

Amazon’s Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) team is looking for a passionate, results-oriented Business Analyst to support Account Integrity’s mission is to prevent bad actors from taking over existing good Customer accounts (events referred to as ATOs), and from creating new Amazon accounts (bad actor accounts, or BAAs).

Key job responsibilities

As a Business Analyst in BRP, you will be responsible for analyzing terabytes of data to identify specific instances of risk, broader risk trends and points of customer friction, developing scalable solutions for prevention. In addition you will be responsible for building a robust set of operational and business metrics and will utilize metrics to determine improvement opportunities.

Key job responsibilities

Understand the various operations across BRP
Understand the requirements of stakeholders and map them with the data sources/data warehouse
Design and develop highly available dashboards and metrics using Tableau, Excel and SQL.
Provide wing-to-wing project lifecycle execution (project planning, execution, risk assessment and system availability)
Execute high priority (i.e. cross functional, high impact) projects to improve operations performance with the help of Operations Analytics managers
Perform business analysis and data queries
Execute analytical projects and understanding of analytical methods (like ANOVA, Distribution theory, regression)
Identify new pattern of abuse and make recommendations for new controls and improved monitoring
Develop and oversee the initiation of strategy recommendations

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
5+ years of business or financial analysis experience
5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
Experience with SQL

Preferred Qualifications

Experience partnering with executive-level leaders to identifying and solving business issues

jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Travel Operations Analyst resides with the Global Intelligence Operations (GIO) - Intelligence Operations Center (IOC), supporting the Country Security Operations Center (CSOC) by providing continuous monitoring, situational awareness, and operational support for global employees, events, and executive travel. This role focuses on real‑time travel visibility, monitoring of emerging events impacting dynamic assets, and coordination activities that enable duty of care coverage 24/7/365.

Operating within established procedures and escalation frameworks, the Travel Operations Analyst plays a critical execution‑level role in assessing evolving global incidents, identifying potential impacts to dynamic traveling populations, initiating direct outreach and/or supporting response coordination, and maintaining accurate operational records in a fast‑paced security operations environment. Unlike traditional monitoring functions focused on static assets, this role continuously monitors dynamic human assets, requiring continuous impact assessment, independent judgment, direct stakeholder engagement, and coordination with high-profile teams during rapidly evolving incidents.

Primary Responsibilities

Monitor global employee and executive travel activity using approved traveler tracking and travel security platforms
Maintain real‑time awareness of global security, environmental, political, and operational events that may impact traveler safety or mobility
Evaluate developing incidents affecting dynamic traveler populations whose locations, itineraries, and exposure levels can change rapidly
Identify travelers potentially affected by developing incidents or disruptions and initiate appropriate notifications or escalations
Review, triage, and document travel‑related alerts, advisories, and system notifications in accordance with established procedures
Support executive and high-profile traveler movements through enhanced monitoring and direct stakeholder coordination during elevated risk events
Support coordination with Executive Protection and Event Security teams, regional security partners, and CSOC counterparts during routine and emerging situations
Assist with traveler outreach, follow‑up messaging, and location verification as directed
Provide accurate traveler location and contextual information to support incident response and non‑standard escalations
Maintain clear, timely, and defensible documentation of travel monitoring activities, alerts, and incidents
Participate in structured shift handovers to ensure continuity of awareness and operational coverage
Prioritize and manage tasks effectively during periods of increased operational tempo or global activity
Escalate issues that fall outside defined procedures or risk thresholds to senior operators or leadership as required

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications

1+ years of experience in security operations, travel security, intelligence operations, or a related role
Experience working in a Security Operations Center (SOC) or operations center environment
Demonstrated ability to follow established processes while applying judgment within defined guidelines
Proven solid written and verbal communication skills suited to operational environments
Proven high attention to detail and accuracy when handling time‑sensitive or safety‑related information
Proven ability to work effectively in a shift‑based, fast‑paced operational setting

Required Skillsets And Competencies

Situational awareness and operational monitoring
Incident triage and structured escalation
Adherence to procedures and operational discipline
Clear and concise operational communication
Team collaboration within a 24/7 operations center
Problem solving within established guidelines
Organization, task prioritization, and documentation
Professional judgment and accountability in routine operational decisions

Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data with a strong understanding and application of analytical techniques.

Engage with internal customers to understand their priorities and translate the requirements into solutions.

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Experience handling confidential information
Experience with open source investigation techniques
Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail

Collaborates with clinical, operational, and analytics stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and ensure consistency in reported data.
Develops and maintains documentation of regulatory measure logic, data definitions, workflows, and reporting processes to support validation, auditability, and sustainable program execution. Supports clinical leadership in operationalizing regulatory quality programs and performance improvement initiatives aligned with organizational goals.
Follows established City of Hope and department policies, procedures, objectives, performance improvement, attendance, safety, environmental, and infection control guidelines, including adherence to the workplace code of Conduct and Compliance Plan.
Practices a high level of integrity and honesty in maintaining confidentiality.
Performs other related duties as assigned or requested.

Seven years of relevant experience in healthcare regulatory programs, quality analytics, clinical informatics, or program management within a healthcare environment
Demonstrated experience working with regulatory quality reporting, EHR-based data capture, and cross-functional program coordination required

Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description

Position Purpose:

The Territorial Health and Safety Manager role exists to oversee the day-to-day management of The Salvation Army’s Territorial Health and Safety Program, ensuring a consistent, compliant, and effective approach to health and safety across diverse jurisdictions in Canada. Reporting to the Territorial Director of Health, Safety and Wellbeing, the role is responsible for supporting developing policies, standards, processes, and training programs that support legislative compliance and promote a safe and healthy work environment.

By providing expert guidance, coaching, and client service to leaders and employees, the role helps mitigate risk, strengthen organizational accountability, and foster a culture of safety. This contribution supports The Salvation Army’s mission by protecting its people, ensuring regulatory compliance, and enabling safe and effective service delivery across the organization.

Key Accountabilities

Support the design, development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Territorial Health and Safety Program, ensuring consistent application of policies, procedures, and standards across the organization.
Monitor legislative and regulatory changes across jurisdictions and lines of business, updating programs and policies to maintain compliance and minimize organizational risk.
Oversee the execution of portfolio initiatives, timelines, and communication plans to ensure effective, timely, and sustainable program delivery.
Provide subject matter expertise on health and safety matters, supporting the design of business processes, systems, and solutions that strengthen program effectiveness.
Establish performance measures, metrics, and reporting frameworks to assess program success, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making.
Evaluate program and service effectiveness through qualitative and quantitative analysis, recommending improvements that enhance compliance, safety outcomes, and operational performance.
Partner with Divisional leaders and management teams to provide guidance, coaching, and support in the interpretation and application of health and safety policies and practices.
Develop and deliver communication, change management, education, and training initiatives, while preparing strategic recommendations and presentations for senior leadership and supporting special projects as required.

Education And Experience Qualifications

Completion of university degree or equivalent with health & safety or related focus
Has or is working towards a professional designation, such as CRSP, is an asset
A minimum of 7 years of prior related experience, including consulting experience.
Experience working as a H&S Specialist/advisor in a national/multi-provincial organization.
Experience in effectively launching new on-line processes integrated into H&S/HRIS systems.
Commitment to The Salvation Army’s mission, values, and culture, with the ability to align health and safety initiatives to organizational objectives and service delivery.
Strong leadership and relationship-building skills, with the ability to quickly establish credibility as a trusted advisor, coach, and strategic partner.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.
Proven change management capabilities, including building trust, influencing stakeholders, and facilitating alignment during organizational change and program implementation.

jobs.description:
Overview

Abacus Technology is seeking an Information System Security Manager (ISSM) to ensure system and application deliverables meet all required cyber security policies and regulations for the Technical Advisory and Assistance Services (TAAS) program at Hanscom AFB. This is a full-time position.

Responsibilities

Support system/application Assessment and Authorization (A&A) efforts, to include assessing and guiding the quality and completeness of A&A activities, tasks, and resulting artifacts mandated by governing National, DoD, and Department of the Air Force policies (i.e., RMF).
Recommend policies and procedures to ensure the reliability of and accessibility to information systems and to prevent and defend against unauthorized access to systems, networks, and data.
Conduct risk and vulnerability assessments and inspections of planned and installed information systems to identify vulnerabilities, risks, and protection needs.
Evaluate threats and vulnerabilities to information systems to ascertain the need for additional safeguards.
Evaluate system sources of changes such as Deficiency Reports (DRs), Problem Reports (PRs), Change Requests/Proposals (CRs/CPs), and AF Form 1067s; provide inputs to the root cause analysis reporting and the formulation of recommended solution from alternatives; determine the security impacts of proposed or actual changes to the system, environment, threats, and vulnerabilities; and if any, document in written reports the changes/revisions to the system’s RMF artifacts.
Review and provide inputs to modification packages, program/system documents and support agreements updates, and communications and network infrastructure upgrades to ensure proper cybersecurity configuration modification management; implementation of technical, managerial, operational requirements; and support requirements (e.g. planning, testing, test infrastructure, documentation, training, etc.) are identified.
Review system test plans and test results and if necessary, observe system testing for security control implementation in accordance with cybersecurity policies, guidance, and plan.
Perform security impact analysis on any system change and appropriately prepare letters of assurance, security impact letters, and risk assessment letters to include exceptions, deviations, or waivers to cybersecurity requirements when applicable.
Continuously monitor intelligence and open-source information for vulnerabilities affecting systems, assess risk, and provide POA&M recommendations.
Promote awareness of security issues among management and ensuring sound security principles are reflected in organizations’ visions and goals.
Conduct systems security monitoring, evaluations, audits, and reviews.
Recommend systems security contingency plans and disaster recovery procedures.
Recommend and implementing programs to ensure that systems, network, and data users are aware of, understand, and adhere to systems security policies and procedures.
Participate in network and systems (to include cryptographic) design to ensure implementation of appropriate systems security policies.
Facilitate the gathering, analysis, and preservation of evidence used in the prosecution of computer crimes.
Assess security events to determine impact and implementing corrective actions.
Ensure the rigorous application of cybersecurity and cryptographic policies, principles, and practices throughout the system development lifecycle.
Author, monitor, and record system information in applicable databases.
Prepare and record system, security status, and portfolio management information into the Air Force Information Technology Investment Portfolio Suite (referred to as ITIPS) for FISMA; Security, Interoperability, Supportability, Sustainability, Usability (SISSU); Clinger Cohen Act; and other statutory compliance.
Author, review, certify, and/or maintain security management plans and RMF package artifacts including but not limited to: RMF Implementation Plans, System Security Management Plans, Information Support Plans, Program Protection Plans (PPPs), Security Risk Analyses, Security Vulnerability and Countermeasure Analyses, Vulnerability Management Plans, Common Control Packages, Security Concepts of Operations, OPSEC Plans, Authority-to-Connect guest system packages, and other system/network security related documents.
Support and assist external teams in the evaluation of systems Cybersecurity posture to include teams performing non-regular cyber tests, war-games, cyber penetration tests, and cyber studies conducted by the NSA, DISA, Air Force Audit Agency, or other organizations.
Support the development, coordination, and implementation of cybersecurity-related special projects and taskers, e.g., Defensive Cyber Operations (DCO), Higher Headquarter requests, Notice to Airmen (NOTAMs), Technical Change Orders (TCOs), System Program Office (SPO), 16th AF, USSTRATCOM, USCYBERCOM, SAF/A6, SpOC/S6, AFGSC/A6, 460 Space Wing, and AFNWC/NC efforts.

Qualifications

3+ years experience in cyber security or information assurance. Bachelor’s degree in a related field. Must hold one of the following certifications: Security+, CISSP, CISM, CASP+/SecurityX, CEH, or CySA+. Experience with the certification and accreditation process. Significant experience in vulnerability scanning and analysis, including the use of automated tools and vulnerability management systems. Knowledge of intrusion prevention and network access control tools/systems. Understanding of system audit principles and security risk assessment. Strong understanding of security policy advocated by the U.S. Government including the Department of Defense and appropriate civil agencies, e.g., NIST. Able to perform work that involves ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of systems, networks, and data through the planning, analysis, development, implementation, maintenance, and enhancement of information systems security programs, policies, procedures, and tools. Knowledge of cryptography and cryptographic key management concepts. General experience includes development of both common user and special purpose command and control/information systems with increasing responsibilities in the scope and magnitude of the systems for which solutions have been implemented. Must have a solid understanding of network infrastructure and mission assurance. Familiar with Federal government and DOD standards for IA/security including DIACAP, FISMA, NIST, and OMB. Must have solid communications skills and be capable of working with all levels of an organization. Must be a US Citizen and hold a current Top Secret clearance.

The projected compensation range for this position is $175,800-$195,100. There are multiple factors that can impact a final salary, including, but not limited to, Contract Wage Determination, relevant work experience, skills and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location (if remote or different from the stated location for this position), education and certifications as well as Federal Government Contract Labor categories. In addition, Abacus Technology offers a benefits package that includes: Health and Dental Insurance; 401(k) and Matching; Life Insurance; Short- and Long-Term Disability; Paid Time Off; Paid Holidays; and Professional Membership, Technical Training, Certification, and Education Assistance.

Overview

This is a hybrid position and will be located at our Foot Locker office. In-Office schedule is Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday with Monday and Friday being remote.

Office location is:

2 Pennsylvania Plaza New York, New York 10121

Great brands reflect culture. The best ones help shape it. At Foot Locker, we’re rooted in sport, powered by style, and driven by the communities that move both. From Foot Locker and Kids Foot Locker to Champs Sports, WSS, and atmos, our brands sit at the intersection of sport, style, and self-expression.

As part of the DICK’S Sporting Goods family, you’re backed by the resources, reach, and career opportunities of a world-class sports company. That unleashes Foot Locker to keep pushing forward with the agility and edge that define the brand. We’re looking for great people who want to influence culture and the generation that is shaping what’s next.

Whether you’re building strategy, shaping innovations, or creating unforgettable customer moments, you’ll contribute to decisions and experiences that define our brands’ impact in the communities we serve.

Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Analyst to join our Customer Analytics team within Global Data & Analytics. This role will transform complex customer data into actionable insights that guide business strategy, strengthen vendor partnerships, and support informed decision-making across the organization. The analyst will help expand access to trusted customer analytics and insights across the organization, including for the Executive Leadership Team. This role involves:

Serve as a customer analytics lead for strategic business questions, using internal and external data to identify customer health trends, growth opportunities, behavioral shifts, and performance drivers.
Partner with business teams and vendors to evaluate initiatives through a customer lens, clearly identifying what is working, what is not working, why it matters, and what actions should follow.
Develop scalable dashboards, reporting, analytical frameworks, and executive-ready narratives that broaden access to trusted customer intelligence across the organization.
Translate customer data into business value by connecting insights to customer acquisition, engagement, retention, loyalty, channel behavior, category performance, and long-term growth.

Come change the game with us. Apply today!

Responsibilities

Lead analyses of customer purchase, engagement, demographic, loyalty, channel, product, and digital behavior to identify meaningful trends, opportunities, and risks.
Partner with Merchandising, Marketing, Media, Finance, Digital, Strategy, and other teams to frame business questions and develop customer-centered analytical approaches.
Evaluate business and vendor performance from the customer point of view, including who is buying, how behavior is changing, where engagement is strengthening or declining, and what is driving outcomes.
Develop and maintain customer health reporting, executive dashboards, scorecards, and self-service tools that give leaders consistent access to trusted insights.
Create vendor and brand insights that help internal partners and external vendors understand customer overlap, acquisition, retention, cross-shopping, channel behavior, category preferences, and growth opportunities.
Synthesize complex findings into clear executive narratives, identifying what is working, what is not working, the business implications, and recommended actions.
Conduct deep-dive and ad hoc analyses to answer priority business questions and uncover emerging customer opportunities.
Establish clear analytical methodologies, definitions, and documentation to ensure customer insights are consistent, transparent, and reproducible.
Partner with Data Engineering and data product teams to expand customer data availability, improve analytical datasets, and address gaps that limit insight generation.
Implement validation and monitoring processes that maintain high standards for data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
Transform business inquiries into innovative analytical solutions, aligning data teams and business partners on objectives, methodology, outputs, and expected decisions.
Present customer insights and recommendations through compelling presentations and direct stakeholder engagement that improve decision-making at both working-team and executive levels.
Use SQL, Power BI, Adobe Analytics, and other analytical tools to build an expert understanding of customer behavior across channels (stores and digital), banners, markets, brands, and categories.
Support customer data integrity investigations, validate fixes, and communicate implications to business stakeholders.
Keep analytical deliverables, methodologies, and priorities organized and transparent for partners.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Analytics, or a related field required.
Minimum of 4 years of experience in customer analytics, business analytics, marketing analytics, or a related analytical role.
At least 2 years of experience writing advanced SQL queries required.
At least 2 years of experience working with customer, transaction, loyalty, or digital behavioral data required; experience with a customer data platform is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex analyses into concise business narratives, actionable recommendations, and executive-ready presentations.
Experience building dashboards, scorecards, or self-service reporting in Power BI or a comparable business intelligence platform.
Strong understanding of customer metrics and analytical methods related to acquisition, retention, loyalty, segmentation, lifetime value, channel behavior, and performance trends.
Hands-on experience with at least one analytics-oriented programming language such as Python, Scala, or R is preferred.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills and working knowledge of digital analytics tools such as Adobe Analytics.
Self-motivated, intellectually curious team player with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with technical teams, business partners, vendors, and senior leaders.

Cameras must be on for all virtual interviews.

About The Company

Guidehouse is a leading management consulting firm dedicated to solving complex challenges for government, commercial, and nonprofit clients. With a strong focus on innovation, integrity, and excellence, Guidehouse delivers strategic solutions across various industries, including healthcare, energy, financial services, and public sector. The company prides itself on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and collaboration. As an organization committed to making a positive impact, Guidehouse leverages cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices to help clients achieve their objectives and drive sustainable success.

About The Role

We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our AI & Data team at Guidehouse. In this role, you will be instrumental in helping federal government clients unlock the full potential of their data assets. You will work on a variety of projects that involve data querying, wrangling, engineering, visualization, and predictive analytics. Your expertise will support organizational and mission-driven goals by designing innovative data solutions that facilitate data-driven decision-making, enhance operational efficiency, and improve strategic planning. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of technical proficiency and excellent communication skills, enabling effective collaboration with stakeholders at all levels.

Qualifications

The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal or DoD "Public Trust" clearance. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related STEM discipline is required. Additionally, candidates should have at least one year of experience in business analytics, data analysis, data engineering, data visualization, or data science. Familiarity with cloud-based analytics environments, such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Impala, is highly desirable. Proficiency in SQL, Python, and R for data transformation and analysis is essential. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and within a team are critical for success in this role.

Responsibilities

Design and develop data visualization dashboards and analytics solutions using Tableau to deliver actionable insights tailored to client needs.
Lead and review data cleaning and transformation scripts utilizing tools such as Databricks, SQL, and Python, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
Maintain, enhance, and troubleshoot dashboards, reports, and analytics tools used in operational and strategic decision-making processes.
Identify opportunities for workflow automation, process optimization, and improved data handling, contributing to implementation efforts.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define use cases, gather requirements, and translate business needs into scalable data science solutions.
Support client engagement activities by presenting findings, demonstrating solutions, and providing technical expertise.
Contribute to business development efforts through responses to RFPs, RFQs, and RFIs, as well as preparing white papers and proposals.
Participate in internal initiatives focused on knowledge sharing, skill development, and staying current with emerging technologies in data science and analytics.

Benefits

Guidehouse offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage, along with personal and family sick leave, and paid holidays. The position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus. We provide parental leave and adoption assistance to support work-life balance. Employees can participate in our 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions. Additional benefits include basic and supplemental life insurance, health savings accounts, flexible spending accounts for dental, vision, and dependent care, short-term and long-term disability coverage, and student loan repayment programs. We also invest in our employees’ development through tuition reimbursement, skills training, certifications, and learning opportunities. Our employee referral program, community engagement activities, and emergency backup childcare further enhance our supportive work environment.

Equal Opportunity

Guidehouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws and ordinances, including the Fair Chance Ordinance of Los Angeles and San Francisco. We encourage all candidates to apply and will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process to ensure equal access. Our commitment to fostering an inclusive environment extends to all aspects of employment, ensuring that every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute to our collective success.

Summary of Job Duties:

The Business Intelligence Analyst / Developer designs, develops, and maintains reporting solutions, data products, and automated processes supporting Institutional Advancement’s Salesforce CRM environment. The position uses SQL, data modeling, ETL processes, Salesforce reporting, and business intelligence tools to transform institutional data into accurate, accessible, and actionable information.

The position manages the full reporting lifecycle, including gathering requirements, preparing and validating data, developing reports and dashboards, delivering results, documenting business logic, and converting recurring requests into reusable or automated solutions. The individual works with technical and nontechnical stakeholders to translate business questions into reliable reporting products.

As reporting technologies continue to evolve, the position also designs, tests, and manages AI-assisted reporting and automation processes. This includes developing prompts and instructions, establishing business rules and human-review checkpoints, evaluating outputs, monitoring process performance, and identifying appropriate uses of emerging AI capabilities. The position ensures that reporting and AI-assisted processes protect sensitive data and comply with approved definitions, security requirements, and institutional standards.

The ideal candidate is a practical problem-solver who can work across the reporting stack, learn new technologies quickly, communicate clearly, and build sustainable solutions rather than one-time outputs.

High School diploma/GED plus six (6) years of experience in data analysis, database management, reporting development, or business intelligence required.

Experience with Salesforce CRM reporting and dashboard development.

Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

Design, develop, maintain, and optimize Salesforce reports, dashboards, datasets, queries, and related reporting solutions.

Job Category
