Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

About The Role

Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists
— engagement leaders who serve as the operational backbone, program lead, and business strategist for high-stakes customer migrations and platform modernizations. Operating in an AI-native delivery framework, you own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for fast-paced, high-impact engagements (typically 12 weeks or less) that transition enterprise customers to modern platforms like MC Next, Revenue Cloud, Tableau, and Data Cloud.

You're a hybrid of Program Manager, Engagement Lead, and Business Analyst. Rather than managing a schedule from the sidelines, you lead engagement strategy, direct cross-functional delivery pods, run executive governance, and use modern AI tools to accelerate discovery and execution — keeping complex migrations on track and ensuring enterprise customers see value fast.

What You'll Be Doing

Own engagement success end-to-end as the single point of accountability across the full lifecycle: Discovery → Migration Strategy → Execution Oversight → Value Realization & Handoff
Establish engagement governance, track critical-path milestones, manage scope, and proactively resolve delivery risks
Direct the day-to-day rhythm of cross-functional teams, including internal Migration Leads, Professional Services consultants, and SI Partners — keeping them unblocked and aligned on scope and delivery dates
Serve as the primary trusted contact for VP- and C-suite customer stakeholders, translating complex migration workstreams into clear business outcomes
Lead steering committee reviews and help customers navigate organizational change
Personally lead discovery workshops and "Jobs-to-be-Done" reviews, auditing legacy business processes and mapping requirements to standardized target platform patterns
Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and automation agents) to synthesize legacy documentation, extract business logic, auto-generate project assets, and accelerate delivery workflows
Assess customer organizational readiness, define change enablement paths, and lead operational handoffs post-migration to support lasting adoption

Required Qualifications

8+ years leading enterprise customer delivery, technical program management (TPM), engagement management, or management consulting for enterprise SaaS transitions
Proven track record owning enterprise engagement scopes, managing cross-functional delivery teams, and running tight, time-bound client engagements with strict milestone discipline
Strong background in program governance, scope management, business process analysis, and executive stakeholder management
Experience orchestrating delivery alongside Professional Services teams, System Integrators (SIs), and external customer teams
Broad working understanding of enterprise cloud platforms across Marketing, Revenue/CPQ, Analytics, or Data Cloud ecosystems (MC Next, Revenue Cloud, Tableau, or Data Cloud)
Practical experience using AI productivity tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate program analysis, documentation, and operational efficiency
Willingness to travel up to 25% to customer sites as needed
Degree or equivalent relevant experience required.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in a Success Architect, Solution Architect, or similar customer-facing delivery role at an enterprise software company
Familiarity with Salesforce's platform ecosystem and migration methodologies
Experience building or refining AI-accelerated delivery playbooks

What's in It for You

You'll operate at the center of Salesforce's highest-stakes customer migrations, with direct influence on how enterprises modernize their platforms. You'll work alongside Professional Services, SI partners, and product teams while pushing the boundaries of AI-native delivery.

Our Commitment to Equality

We believe in equal treatment for all employees and applicants, and we are committed to building a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve — hiring without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Legal, Amazon Health Services
jobs.description:
Description

Are you excited about using AI to reimagine how legal work gets done? The Amazon Health Services (AHS) Legal team is looking for a Program Manager who can turn manual, time-consuming processes into scalable, AI-powered workflows. As the team grows to meet the demands of growing businesses, including Amazon One Medical and Amazon Pharmacy, this role will be instrumental in rebuilding and modernizing how our legal team operates, so we can spend more time enabling the business and less time on repetitive tasks.

You will work at the intersection of legal operations and technology, identifying where automation can replace manual effort and designing the right tools to make it happen. You bring experience configuring AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, or no-code/low-code solutions, paired with the judgment to know when a solution is ready to ship and the discipline to measure whether it delivers real value. This role involves access to confidential legal information and requires a high level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.

Key job responsibilities

Own the program roadmap for legal process automation: define milestones, manage cross-team dependencies, identify risks early, and drive timely resolution or escalation to keep delivery on track.
Evaluate, pilot, and build AI-powered tools and workflows that replace manual legal and compliance processes, measuring adoption and time savings to validate impact.
Partner with attorneys, compliance professionals, and business teams across multiple business lines to identify trends, recurring pain points, and opportunities for automation.
Define success metrics and build reporting frameworks that give leadership clear visibility into program health, operational efficiency, and vendor performance.
Collaborate with other Program Managers across the organization to share best practices, avoid duplicated effort, and raise the bar on program management standards.

A day in the life

You will split your time between collaborative and independent work. Part of your week involves meeting with attorneys and business partners to understand their workflows, spot patterns, and prioritize where automation will have the greatest impact. The rest is heads-down time — researching tools, designing solutions, testing prototypes, and iterating based on user feedback. This is an individual contributor role, so you will own your projects end to end while staying closely connected to the broader PM community across Amazon Legal.

About The Team

The AHS Legal team is dedicated to enabling Amazon's healthcare businesses. We partner closely with business teams to build smart legal frameworks that accelerate innovation. We value curiosity, collaboration, and a sense of humor, and we believe the best legal support comes from understanding the business deeply enough to stay ahead of its needs.

3+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
Bachelor's degree

2+ years of driving process improvements experience

Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization

This role ensures Academy programs, learning pathways, coaching offerings, and related resources are aligned, scalable, and responsive to evolving organizational needs.

This role collaborates closely with the Executive sponsor, Training and Organizational Development Specialists, executive leaders, subject matter experts, and external partners to identify organizational needs, assess program effectiveness, manage the Academy portfolio, and recommend enhancements that support leadership development across the Health System and ensure leaders across Mount Sinah have access to a cohesive, high-quality, and evolving learning experience.

Responsibilities

Leads the day-to-day administration and operational management, governance, and continuous improvement of the Mount Sinai Leadership Academy and its portfolio of leadership development offerings.
Partners with the Executive Sponsor to operationalize the Academy’s strategic priorities and translate them into actionable plans, initiatives, and learning pathways.
Oversees the Academy portfolio, including program planning, prioritization, resource coordination, and support for executing the leadership development programs, workshops, coaching offerings, learning pathways, leadership resources, and related initiatives.
Serves as the steward of the Mount Sinai Leadership Academy brand, ensuring consistent messaging, positioning, marketing, and communication of Academy offerings across the Health System.
Develops and executes communication and engagement strategies that increase awareness, participation, and utilization of leadership development opportunities.
Maintains oversight of Academy resources, learning pathways, program inventories, websites, communications, and supporting materials to ensure information remains current, accessible, and aligned
Conducts ongoing needs assessments, stakeholder consultations, environmental scans, and industry research to identify leadership capability gaps, emerging trends, and opportunities for program enhancement.
Evaluates the effectiveness and impact of leadership development programs using participant feedback, evaluation data, organizational metrics, and stakeholder input.
Develops and implements recommendations for program enhancements, redesigns, expansions, retirements, and new leadership development offerings based on evaluation findings and to evolving organizational priorities
Establishes and maintains Academy governance processes, and reporting processes that support data-driven decision-making, program quality, consistency, and continuous improvement.
Develops dashboards, scorecards, reports, presentations, and executive summaries that communicate participation trends, outcomes, impact measures, and strategic recommendations.
Partners with Chief Learning Officer, Executive Sponsor, Training and Organizational Development Specialists, and leaders to ensure Academy offerings complement broader talent and leadership development initiatives.
Establishes and maintains relationships with internal faculty, facilitators, executive sponsors, vendors, consultants, and external partners supporting Academy initiatives.
Coordinates Academy planning activities, stakeholder meetings, portfolio reviews, communications, and special projects to support strategic decision-making and program execution.
Supports development and management of Academy budgets, contracts, and external partnerships as assigned.

7+ years of experience in program management.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Talent Development
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

Hiring And How We Work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Sr. Program Manager, Talent Development

About The Job

This position is needed to build and lead the live learning experiences that shape how Twilions grow, lead, and work together. You will design and facilitate Twilio's development programs, design and lead leadership team offsites, and serve as an internal coach to leaders and emerging talent around the globe.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Talent Development, you will spend most of your time in the room, virtual or in person, with Twilions: designing programs, facilitating sessions, guiding leadership teams through high-stakes offsites, and coaching leaders through pivotal growth moments. The ideal candidate is an expert facilitator and credentialed coach who designs with rigor, reads a room in real time, and turns every session into measurable behavior change.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

Design and build facilitated development programs end to end, from needs assessment and learning objectives through facilitator guides, participant materials, and experiential activities, for leaders, managers, and individual contributors globally.
Facilitate Twilio's development programs in person, virtually, and in hybrid formats, delivering engaging, inclusive sessions that build skills and shift behavior across a global, remote-first workforce.
Design and facilitate leadership team offsites and team effectiveness sessions, partnering with senior leaders to define outcomes, build agendas, guide strategic conversations, and drive clear commitments and follow-through.
Serve as an internal coach to leaders and high-potential talent, delivering one-on-one and team coaching engagements and embedding coaching into development programs to reinforce learning.
Build internal facilitation capability by developing and certifying a bench of facilitators, and set the design and delivery standards for Talent Development programs.
Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to diagnose capability gaps and determine whether training, coaching, or a facilitated team intervention is the right solution.
Measure the impact of programs, offsites, and coaching through participant feedback, behavior change, and business outcomes, and use the data to continuously iterate.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in Organizational Development, Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Adult Learning, Education, or a related field preferred.
7-10 years in talent development, with 7+ years designing and facilitating leadership, manager, and professional development programs.
Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating executive and leadership team offsites, including strategic planning, team alignment, and team effectiveness sessions.
Expert facilitation skills across in-person, virtual, and hybrid formats, with the ability to engage diverse global audiences and navigate challenging group dynamics in real time.
Strong instructional design skills grounded in adult learning principles, including building facilitator guides and programs that scale through train-the-trainer models.
Executive presence with the ability to build trust quickly, deliver candid feedback, and maintain strict confidentiality with senior leaders.
Experience using learning and coaching data, including feedback, behavior change, and business metrics, to demonstrate impact and drive program decisions.
Willingness to travel for in-person programs and offsites (approx. 25%).

Desired

Certification in assessment tools such as Hogan, DiSC, MBTI, or 360-degree feedback instruments.
Experience building an internal coaching program or a facilitator certification pathway.
Experience applying AI tools to accelerate program design, personalize learning, or extend the reach of coaching.
Ability to effectively prioritize a full facilitation and coaching calendar in a fast-paced, ever-changing culture.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you will travel regularly to facilitate in-person programs and leadership offsites (approx. 25%).

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $128,560.00-$160,700.00..
Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $136,000.00-$170,000.00..
Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $151,120.00-$188,900.00.
This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 10/14/26, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

About The Role

Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists
— engagement leaders who serve as the operational backbone, program lead, and business strategist for high-stakes customer migrations and platform modernizations. Operating in an AI-native delivery framework, you own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for fast-paced, high-impact engagements (typically 12 weeks or less) that transition enterprise customers to modern platforms like MC Next, Revenue Cloud, Tableau, and Data Cloud.

You're a hybrid of Program Manager, Engagement Lead, and Business Analyst. Rather than managing a schedule from the sidelines, you lead engagement strategy, direct cross-functional delivery pods, run executive governance, and use modern AI tools to accelerate discovery and execution — keeping complex migrations on track and ensuring enterprise customers see value fast.

What You'll Be Doing

Own engagement success end-to-end as the single point of accountability across the full lifecycle: Discovery → Migration Strategy → Execution Oversight → Value Realization & Handoff
Establish engagement governance, track critical-path milestones, manage scope, and proactively resolve delivery risks
Direct the day-to-day rhythm of cross-functional teams, including internal Migration Leads, Professional Services consultants, and SI Partners — keeping them unblocked and aligned on scope and delivery dates
Serve as the primary trusted contact for VP- and C-suite customer stakeholders, translating complex migration workstreams into clear business outcomes
Lead steering committee reviews and help customers navigate organizational change
Personally lead discovery workshops and "Jobs-to-be-Done" reviews, auditing legacy business processes and mapping requirements to standardized target platform patterns
Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and automation agents) to synthesize legacy documentation, extract business logic, auto-generate project assets, and accelerate delivery workflows
Assess customer organizational readiness, define change enablement paths, and lead operational handoffs post-migration to support lasting adoption

Required Qualifications

What We're Looking For

8+ years leading enterprise customer delivery, technical program management (TPM), engagement management, or management consulting for enterprise SaaS transitions
Proven track record owning enterprise engagement scopes, managing cross-functional delivery teams, and running tight, time-bound client engagements with strict milestone discipline
Strong background in program governance, scope management, business process analysis, and executive stakeholder management
Experience orchestrating delivery alongside Professional Services teams, System Integrators (SIs), and external customer teams
Broad working understanding of enterprise cloud platforms across Marketing, Revenue/CPQ, Analytics, or Data Cloud ecosystems (MC Next, Revenue Cloud, Tableau, or Data Cloud)
Practical experience using AI productivity tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate program analysis, documentation, and operational efficiency
Willingness to travel up to 25% to customer sites as needed
Degree or equivalent relevant experience required.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in a Success Architect, Solution Architect, or similar customer-facing delivery role at an enterprise software company
Familiarity with Salesforce's platform ecosystem and migration methodologies
Experience building or refining AI-accelerated delivery playbooks

What's in It for You

You'll operate at the center of Salesforce's highest-stakes customer migrations, with direct influence on how enterprises modernize their platforms. You'll work alongside Professional Services, SI partners, and product teams while pushing the boundaries of AI-native delivery.

Our Commitment to Equality

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in equal treatment for all employees and applicants, and we are committed to building a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve — hiring without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. The typical base salary range for this position is $150,100 - $273,000 annually. In select cities within the San Francisco and New York City metropolitan area, the base salary range for this role is $180,200 - $298,400 annually. The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

jobs.description:
Description

AWS Partner Agreements is building the operational backbone for how AWS structures, executes, and governs its partner agreement programs at scale. We are looking for a Deal Desk Program Manager to run the engine: processing high-volume partner agreement nominations, executing deals end-to-end, managing post-signature compliance, and building the automations that make the entire operation faster.

You will operate a system-driven deal desk where bulk partner nominations flow through automated qualification gates, then land on your desk for execution. You will process deals through automated workflows, triage edge cases, coordinate across legal, finance, and field teams, and own the full post-signature lifecycle. You will

also be the person who identifies where the system breaks and builds the tactical fixes: scripts, workflow enhancements, CPQ improvements,

and process automations that increase throughput.

This is a high-ownership, high-volume role. You will be the first and last person to touch most deals. Your feedback on friction points, system gaps, and edge cases directly shapes how the deal desk evolves.

Key job responsibilities

Operate the deal desk at scale: process partner agreement nominations through qualification, approval, execution, and documentation workflows
Triage nominations that fall outside standard criteria, assess edge cases, and route exceptions to senior leadership or BD leads when strategic judgment is needed
Own post-signature operations: compliance tracking, partner onboarding, reporting obligations, and agreement lifecycle management
Build tactical automations across the deal cycle: identify manual bottlenecks and create scripts, workflow enhancements, CPQ improvements, and system integrations that increase throughput
Maintain data integrity in systems of record and produce operational reporting on deal volume, cycle times, and funnel health
Coordinate across legal, finance, field teams, and BD leads on deal-level questions, process improvements, and exception resolution
Surface patterns from deal execution to inform workflow refinement and program iteration

A day in the life

You start the morning processing a batch of partner nominations through the deal desk: checking eligibility, moving deals through approvals, triaging the edge cases. By midday you're coordinating with legal on a contract question and updating a field team on deal status. After lunch you review compliance checkpoints on active agreements and build a quick script to automate a manual step that's been slowing you down. You end the day pulling operational metrics, spotting a pattern in where deals get stuck, and feeding it back to improve the system. Every day is a mix of execution, coordination, and building.

About The Team

We're a small team responsible for how AWS runs its partner agreement programs end-to-end. We design the programs, bring partners in, execute the agreements, and track performance after the ink is dry.

The team sits at a crossroads: legal, finance, sales operations, field teams, and engineering all intersect here. You will work with all of them regularly. Our internal customers are the AWS field teams and partner managers who rely on us to move agreements efficiently. Our external customers are the partners themselves.

We're in the middle of a transformation from manual, spreadsheet-driven processes to a scalable, automated platform. That means there's a lot

to build and a lot of ownership available. If you like greenfield work, fast iteration, and seeing your improvements show up in the numbers the next week, this is that kind of team.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Lead end-to-end planning and delivery of data pipelines, modeling efforts, analytics solutions, dashboards, and data modernization initiatives.
Coordinate cross-functional work across data engineering, BI, data governance, QA, product, and business groups. Manage dependencies across systems and teams to ensure data solutions integrate cleanly and securely.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure
for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Project Manager, you will be expected to leverage deep cross-functional expertise to coordinate with enterprise customers globally, guiding integrations from conception to launch by aligning technical teams, managing timelines, mitigating risks, and ensuring all deliverables meet strategic objectives in the following ways:

Own end-to-end project management for enterprise launches using our brokerage APIs (equities, crypto, options, and more)
Collaborate with external stakeholders (product, engineering, compliance teams, etc.) to scope, plan, and execute integration timelines
Work cross-functionally with internal teams (BD, engineering, legal, compliance, operations and customer success) to resolve issues and align on resources
Facilitate weekly partner check-ins, drive action items, and ensure progress toward key deliverables
Track and report on project status, risks, and dependencies to internal leadership and partner stakeholders
Help partners navigate onboarding requirements, such as KYC, AML and regulatory disclosures
Document processes and continuously improve onboarding frameworks to scale future partner integrations

Internally, the Project Manager is a key person to give the best context of a partner to many teams, including leadership. Simply put, the Project Manager is the voice of the customer internally at Alpaca.

As a project manager in a highly collaborative role, the ideal candidate must demonstrate a strong communication, troubleshooting, solutioning and proactiveness skillset.

Key Responsibilities:

Be the face of Alpaca to some of the largest enterprise businesses in their respective regions
Provide updates to Alpaca’s leadership team, being transparent with successes, blockers and solutions
Stay updated on internal product development timelines, and work closely with the technical teams to roll out new features to partners
Establish yourself as a subject matter expert on Alpaca’s API and collaborate with fintechs around the world
Ensure feature requests by partners are communicated to the technical teams and are adequately prioritized
Support the success team with advice on integration items, including new products
Solutionize for partners targeting key regions Alpaca is focusing on, driving the company's mission to open financial services to everyone on the planet
Create internal and external resources that can be leveraged by both partners and internal teams

Must-Haves:

2+ years of enterprise-level business project management experience with strong process, analysis, design, and documentation skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills for English & Chinese speaking clients to drive clarity on goals, set expectations, and collect feedback
Demonstrated problem-solving ability and attention to detail to deliver high-quality output while meeting deadlines.
Flexibility to work with customers around the world
Familiarity and interest in FinTech, financial markets, and investing applications
Experience with communication and project management tools such as Slack, JIRA, Confluence, Basecamp and Google Workspace
Startup mindset
Sales and customer success background, leading the customer experience
Training/enablement experience
Brokerage/stocks experience
Crypto experience

Technical background, including:

Familiarity with Metabase
Experience with modern APIs (REST, Websockets, Server Sent Events)
Experience with enterprise software implementations
Technical troubleshooting skills
Experience with issue management (JIRA) and API logging tool
Familiarity with Postman and curl requests

How We Take Care of You:

Competitive Salary & Stock Options
Health Benefits
New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Anticipate potential problems and resolve them before they affect quality, budget, or schedule
Help ensure that every finished product meets the aesthetic and quality standards expected in luxury hospitality environments
Keep multiple projects moving forward without allowing important details to get lost

Who You Are You have a professional background in architecture, interior design, lighting design, product design, industrial design, or a related field
You understand design deeply but are more energized by organizing, coordinating, and leading the process
You have excellent visual judgment and a refined sense of proportion, material, color, and finish
You are exceptionally organized and comfortable managing many details across multiple projects
You communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently with clients
You are comfortable leading meetings, presenting information, and navigating difficult conversations
You take ownership of projects and follow through without needing constant direction
You can balance aesthetic goals with technical, budget, production, and schedule requirements
You are proactive, calm under pressure, and skilled at solving problems
You have strong written and spoken English
You are comfortable working with clients and project teams across different countries and time zones

Helpful Experience Experience in any of the following would be especially valuable:
Luxury hospitality, including hotels and restaurants
Custom lighting, furniture, millwork, metalwork, or decorative products
Architectural specifications and construction documents
Shop drawings, submittals, samples, and approval processes
Custom manufacturing or fabrication
Revit, AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite, or other design software
Project-management and collaboration tools

You do not need to be the strongest technical designer in the room. What matters is that you understand design, recognize quality, communicate effectively, and know how to guide a complex creative project from an idea to a beautifully executed finished product.
About Us We design and manufacture custom lighting for luxury hotels, high-end restaurants, and distinctive interior environments around the world.
Our projects bring together design, engineering, craftsmanship, and manufacturing. Every fixture is developed for a particular space, which means every project presents a different creative and technical challenge.
We care deeply about thoughtful design, excellent materials, careful execution, and providing our clients with a responsive and professional experience.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Join iA – Transforming Pharmacy Fulfillment with Innovation and Care

Are you ready to revolutionize pharmacy with cutting-edge automation technology? At iA® (Innovation Associates®), we are at the forefront of transforming how pharmacies manage prescription fulfillment. With over 30 years of experience and innovation, iA is advancing pharmacy automation with solutions such as the NEXiA® Enterprise Software Suite, enabling pharmacists to focus more on patient care while improving operational efficiency. Whether it's in commercial retail, health systems, or government pharmacy settings, we empower our partners to do more with less. We’re looking for passionate and driven individuals like YOU to help shape the future of healthcare. Join us and be part of a team that's changing the way pharmacy works—for the better.

Your Role & Its Purpose

The Project Manager takes the lead on dynamic, small to medium-sized projects, driving them to success with minimal direction. This role involves providing direction of a cross-functional focused team of up to 10 members, while also spearheading sub-teams for larger, high-impact projects and programs that span across multiple functions within the division. It's a fast-paced, pivotal position where you’ll make a tangible difference, influencing key initiatives and shaping the future of the organization!

How You’ll Contribute

Manages, plans, and coordinates activities of projects to ensure that goals or objectives of projects are accomplished within prescribed time frame and funding parameters.  
Reviews project proposal or plan to determine time frame, funding limitations, procedures for accomplishing projects, staffing requirements, and allotment of available resources to various phases of projects.  
Establishes work plan and multi-disciplinary staffing for each phase of project and arranges for recruitment or assignment of project personnel.  
Prepares and delivers comprehensive weekly and recurring project status reports for internal teams and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of progress, risks, and upcoming milestones to facilitate informed decision-making.
May manage sub-contractors and their workforce.  
Directs and coordinates activities of project personnel to ensure project progresses on schedule and within prescribed budget.  
Reviews status reports prepared by project personnel and modified schedules or plans as required.  
Identify, assess, and monitor potential risks throughout the project lifecycle, including financial, operational, and technical risks.
Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies to reduce the impact of identified risks.
Maintain a risk register, ensuring it is updated regularly and that risks are proactively managed.
Provide regular reports on risk status to senior management and stakeholders, recommending adjustments as necessary to keep the project on track.
Confers with project personnel to provide technical advice and to resolve problems.  
May manage Project Supervisors/leaders assigned to specific projects. 

What You Bring To The Table

At least 5 years project management experience.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Business, Engineering, or similar)
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively and be driven by group feedback 
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet given deadlines 
Close attention to detail, without losing sight of the bigger picture 
High sense of personal accountability and self-motivation 

Even Better If You Bring

PMP Certification or willingness to obtain
Experience in Fulfillment & Distribution, Pharmacy Fulfillment, or related industries.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. Employer will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

Compensation Details

The estimated base annual salary range for this position is $85,000 to $115,000, though a candidate’s base annual salary shall be determined on a range of factors, including, but not limited to, qualifications and experience. This position may additionally be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Environmental Conditions

iA adheres to a thorough Job Safety Assessment (JSA) to maintain OSHA compliance in project management and coordination roles. The work environment emphasizes ergonomics, proper lighting, and safe workspaces to mitigate risks. Regular reviews of safety protocols are conducted to ensure a safe and compliant workspace.

Safety Protocols

Safety protocols include ensuring workstations are ergonomically designed, implementing stress management programs and encouraging work-life balance, maintaining clear communication channels for reporting hazards, and providing regular training on project management tools and safety protocols.

Who We Are

iA is not just a technology company – we're a pharmacy fulfillment partner that provides software-enabled solutions and modular hardware to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance the patient-pharmacist relationship. Our products and solutions streamline the prescription process from start to finish, allowing pharmacists to focus on what matters most: their patients.

What excites many people about iA is that we're doing more than responding to changes in the industry. We're helping drive them. Our solutions support pharmacies of all types, and our vision is centered on making pharmacy more efficient, effective, and accessible for everyone it touches.

What Drives Us

Customer Centric – Be bold with calculated decisions to drive value for our partners.
Champion Diversity – Seek diversity within our team, our partners, and our community to strengthen who we are and what we will accomplish, together.
Empower Ownership – Take ownership at every level and within every action to achieve excellence.
Solutions Driven – Understand the problem and anticipate challenges, with a resolve to provide innovative solutions for our partners.
Trust Daringly – Operate with trust of our team, our partners, and our strategy from day one.

Benefits That Matter

Work-Life Balance – Generous time-off, paid volunteer days, and wellness programs to support your well-being.
Comprehensive Benefits – Medical, dental, vision insurance, 401(k) with match, up to 12 weeks of 100% paid parental leave, pet insurance, and more.
Career Growth – Invest in your future through iA University, tuition reimbursement for eligible degree programs and certifications, professional development funding, and ongoing opportunities to learn and grow.
Culture of Ownership – At iA, we empower our employees to take charge and drive change.
Impactful Work – Be part of a team that is transforming the pharmacy industry and improving patient care every day.
Collaborative Environment – Work alongside passionate, like-minded individuals in a company that values teamwork and creativity.

Not the right fit? Explore other opportunities at https://iarx.com/careers

Want to learn more about iA's innovative products, talented people, and culture? Visit us at iARx.com or connect with us on LinkedIn , Facebook , or YouTube . We’d love to share our story with you!

You'll run social media for many client brands at the same time, and nothing will slip. If that sounds exciting rather than terrifying, keep reading.

About Us

Setsail Interactive is a B-Corp certified, full-service marketing agency based in Vancouver, Canada. We run the whole stack for our clients: paid ads, SEO and content, websites, social, email marketing, and outbound. Our clients span trades and home services, professional services, medical and dental, manufacturing, and more.

The Role

We manage social media for a growing roster of client accounts across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and LinkedIn. You'll be the person who makes it all run: planning each month's content, coordinating the people who film, photograph, edit, design, and write it, reviewing everything before it goes out, and publishing it on schedule.

You'll work with video editors, designers, our copywriter, and a Vancouver-based crew who shoot for our local clients. You won't create the content yourself. You'll make sure it gets made, is right, and goes out on time.

This is an execution role, not strategy or paid ads. Strategy is set with each client. Your job is turning it into a calendar and making that calendar happen, for every account.

What You'll Do

Plan

Turn each client's strategy into a monthly content calendar: what posts, where, and when.
Plan shoots for our Vancouver clients so every shoot captures what the calendar needs.
Stay a month ahead: know what each account needs next month before this one ends.

Coordinate production

Work with the team to make sure editors, designers, and shooters have what they need: shot lists, brand guidelines, assets, references, and deadlines.
Schedule shoots with our Vancouver crew and make sure everyone knows when, where, and what to capture.
For clients outside Vancouver, collect the content they send, get it ready, and schedule it ahead.
Track every piece of content from plan to published, and chase anything that's stuck.

Review

Review every video, graphic, and caption before it goes live: brand voice, spelling, accuracy, platform specs, and client requirements.
Give clear, specific feedback when something isn't right, and make sure it gets fixed.
Collect approvals from clients and account managers, and track what's still waiting.

Publish

Schedule and publish posts across every channel in Planable.
Make sure every account posts accurately and on time: no gaps, no duplicates, no post on the wrong client's page.

What Success Looks Like

Every account's calendar is planned a month ahead.
Nothing publishes without being reviewed.
Posts go out on schedule, every time.
The team always knows what's next, and you spot problems before clients do.

Must Have

4+ years in social media or content project management
, including at least 2 years at an agency running multiple client accounts at the same time.
A system.
You can show us how you keep many calendars, deadlines, and people organized without anything falling through.
A sharp eye for copy.
You catch the typo, the off-brand line, and the wrong hashtag before it posts.
Tool fluency:
Planable or a similar social scheduling tool (Later, Hootsuite, Metricool), plus project management tools. We use ClickUp.
Confidence working with creatives:
clear direction, clear feedback, and polite persistence.
Strong written and spoken English.

Roughly half your workday overlapping Pacific (PST) business hours.

Nice to Have

Hands-on experience filming, editing, or designing, so you know what's realistic to ask for.
Experience with North American small-business clients.
A feel for platform specs and formats across TikTok, Reels, and LinkedIn.

We are TRISON

We are a global company dedicated to the digitization of spaces to generate unique experiences through the integration of audiovisual systems, spectacular content and innovative sensory marketing solutions.

department as Project Manager
in our office in A Coruña.

To carry out space design studies for the integration of cutting-edge LED and audiovisual solutions for major international brands.

Ongoing communication with the logistics departments of clients and installers, in order to gather the necessary information on the planning of new openings, monitoring and updating of standards and procedures established by the client.
Management of incidents and complaints attributable to your management area, communicating to the different departments involved, any modification or update of the client's requirements.

Minimum 4 years’ experience in a similar position (logistics and/or foreign trade) preferably in companies in the technology sector.

Coordinar dentro de área logística internacional todas las tareas referentes al diseño, ejecución y coordinación de proyectos estratégicos en la digitalización de espacios.

Comunicación permanente con los departamentos de logística de los clientes e instaladores, con el fin de recabar la información necesaria sobre la planificación de las nuevas aperturas, seguimiento y actualización de normas y procedimientos establecidos por el cliente.

new_jobs.title: Project & Program Manager, Core Operations
new_jobs.description:
Description

The Project/Program Manager position is responsible for governing First Tech’s relationship with Fiserv and the operational performance of the DNA program. The role coordinates vendor performance, SLAs, escalations, contracts and spend, DNA projects and releases, business readiness, cross-functional accountability, and executive reporting to ensure the core platform remains reliable, compliant, strategically aligned, and effectively supported.

Here’s what you can expect from the job and what you need to be successful:

What You'll Do

Serve as the primary business liaison for Fiserv and the DNA core banking platform; manage governance, communications, and strategic alignment.
Monitor Fiserv SLAs, scorecards, case aging, service availability, and delivery performance; drive corrective action
Direct the intake, prioritization, escalation, communication, and closure of Fiserv service inquiries and critical issues.
Lead operational and quarterly business reviews; report performance, risks, issues, decisions, and action items to leadership.
Coordinate contracts, statements of work, purchase orders, invoices, renewals, service credits, and required stakeholder reviews.
Analyze service trends and stakeholder feedback to improve reliability, responsiveness, efficiency, transparency, and vendor value.
Maintain projects or defined workstreams end-to-end by shaping delivery plans, sequencing milestones, and coordinating cross-functional execution to meet intended outcomes.
Partner with stakeholders to clarify goals, success measures, roles, and decision points; manage scope changes through documented tradeoffs and impacts.
Build and maintain delivery governance to improve predictability and reduce delivery friction.
Manage risk, issue, and dependency resolution by driving mitigation plans and surfacing decisions needed to protect timeline, quality, and customer impact.
Develop clear stakeholder communications, including progress reporting and executive-ready summaries that connect work completed to results and next steps.
Coordinate change and readiness activities (communications, training approach, engagement checkpoints) and use feedback to adjust adoption tactics.
Plan and coordinate testing and implementation activities to support smooth releases and operational readiness.
Identify and support process improvements by mapping workflows, documenting procedures, and helping teams reduce rework, cycle time, or operational risk.

Essential Skills

Required Education: Bachelors degree in field relevant to role (or 4 additional years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree)
Required Experience: 2+ years of relevant experience
Demonstrated knowledge of core banking operations, enterprise technology platforms, vendor services, system releases, and production-support processes.
Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs, projects, enhancements, dependencies, risks, testing, and implementations.
Experience managing vendor performance, SLAs, contracts, statements of work, purchase orders, invoices, renewals, and service escalations.
Strong written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence vendors, business partners, technical teams, and senior leaders.
Ability to analyze performance data, identify trends and risks, develop mitigation plans, and drive timely, fact-based decisions.
Demonstrated ability to establish ownership, manage competing priorities, resolve complex issues, and deliver results in a regulated, high-availability environment.
Proficiency with common project tracking/reporting tools and comfort using structured delivery methods.

Location:
Hillsboro, OR 97124 | Rocklin, CA 95765

Target Compensation in Hillsboro, OR:
$83,000 - $99,500 + annual bonus

Target Compensation in Rocklin, CA:
$77,000 - $109,450 + annual bonus

Schedule:
Monday – Friday | Full-Time (Hybrid)

Every great journey begins with a bold idea—and ours is no different. First Tech and DCU were founded on the belief that financial solutions should put people first. The Office of Research amplifies WSU's land-grant mission by partnering with the university community, industry leaders, and other stakeholders to advance, extend, and grow the positive impact of WSU research for the state, region, and nation.

The Senior Project Manager serves as the primary liaison between the Office of Research, researchers, facilities professionals, architects, engineers, contractors, and university leadership to ensure projects support current and future research needs.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Honeywell’s high-visibility F-35 Navigation Team as a Senior Program Manager and help shape the future of mission-critical aerospace navigation systems. Reporting to the F-35 Program Director, you will lead cross-functional teams responsible for planning and executing DMS projects that sustain the viability of the Inertial Navigation and Tactical Navigation Systems on the F-35, while also supporting Trade Study and Special Test Equipment programs. This role offers meaningful technical complexity, strong executive exposure, and the opportunity to expand into additional Navigation programs across the LM Aero portfolio as capacity permits.

Responsibilities

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Own project scope, objectives, and deliverables while partnering closely with engineering, operations, finance, supply chain, and customer-facing teams
Lead matrixed teams to deliver cost, schedule, technical performance, and quality commitments on programs that directly support the F-35 mission
Translate business objectives into clear execution strategies, practical plans, and measurable outcomes
Build and execute integrated project plans within approved budget, schedule, and resource constraints
Adhere to Honeywell’s Integrated Product Delivery & Support (IPDS) process and its phase gate reviews
Employ tools and processes for setting and maintaining robust project and technical baselines
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance PM processes and practices
Identify and mitigate risks; identify and propose opportunities
Engage stakeholders with clear issue summaries, practical options, and timely corrective-action recommendations
Communicate complex project, technical, and financial status with confidence to internal leaders, customer stakeholders, and executive audiences
Comply with OPSEC, CUI, and export regulations and laws
Update Earned Value metrics based on project execution
Ensure project billings are submitted on time

WHY JOIN HONEYWELL

Work on a globally recognized aerospace platform with mission-critical technical impact
Gain visibility with senior leadership, customers, and cross-functional aerospace teams
Build your career through professional development, leadership opportunities, and exposure to complex program execution
Access comprehensive benefits, including medical, vision, dental, mental health support, paid vacation, and retirement benefits as applicable by region

Qualifications

U.S. CITIZENSHIP REQUIREMENT

Must be a US Citizen due to contractual requirements.

The annual base salary range for this position is $173,000-$216,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell Aerospace considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.

This position is incentive eligible

Must Have

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field
6+ years of engineering project management experience, ideally in complex technical or regulated environments
PMI certification or commitment to obtain certification within 6 months, sponsored by Honeywell Aerospace

We Value

Master’s degree in engineering or business
Honeywell Global PE/PM Academy graduation
Proven business and financial acumen
Aerospace background
Experience managing complex Government-funded, Cost-Plus programs
Demonstrated leadership, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to think strategically while tactically setting and achieving goals
Attention to detail and ability to effectively prioritize tasks
Adaptability and flexibility to manage changing project requirements
Experience with Honeywell’s IPDS process
Experience with resource-loaded scheduling and critical path analysis
Experience with Earned Value Management
Strong technical writing and executive presentation skills
Curiosity, passion for innovation, and a commitment to continuous learning
Proven track record of successfully completing complex engineering projects on time and within budget
Strong leadership and project management skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments
Experience in risk management and problem solving
Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies

About Us

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Honeywell Aerospace Products And Services Are Found On Aircraft Across Commercial Aviation, Defense And Space. We Operate Through Three Business Areas

Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology on board 90% of the world's aircraft

About The Role

Muon Space seeks a Senior Program Manager to lead delivery of next-generation satellites for national security missions, including missile warning and tracking. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of payload engineering and rapid-cycle space vehicle development.

The Senior PM is the accountable owner for delivering the program on cost, schedule, and technical performance. You will manage a multi-disciplinary internal team, subcontractors, and a critical-path vendor base for EO/IR payloads, algorithm development, avionics, and space vehicle builds. The role spans the full program lifecycle: design reviews, hardware build, integration and environmental test, launch, and on-orbit operations.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Responsibilities

Program Execution
Own the integrated master schedule, cost baseline, and risk register
Drive the program through preliminary and critical design reviews, payload and spacecraft integration, environmental test, launch, and on-orbit demonstration, meeting customer milestones and contract deliverables
Manage scope, cost, and period of performance against contract milestones and payment events
Lead day-to-day execution of the program team to the contract, running the weekly program cadence, internal design reviews, and readiness reviews; provide status and briefing content to the Mission Manager, who is the customer interface
Own the preparation and quality of contract deliverables, including status reports, design review packages, technical and cost data, test plans, and final reports, for delivery to the customer
Partner with the Mission Manager and Muon's Capture and Business Development teams on follow-on strategy

Subcontractor and Vendor Management
Manage program subcontracts, including mission data processing and algorithm development
Coordinate critical-path vendors for detectors, focal plane arrays, cooler assemblies, and optics across long-lead procurements
Keep subcontract scope, cost, and schedule aligned with prime contract commitments

Technical Leadership and Risk Management
Partner closely with the lead systems engineer and technical leads (payload design, AI&T, optics, electronics, software, mechanisms, thermal, mission systems) to drive technical decisions
Own and actively work the program risk register, including supply chain, integration, launch, and demonstration risks
Resolve cross-functional issues quickly and escalate to functional and program leadership when needed

Compliance and Reporting
Ensure program execution complies with contract requirements, including U.S.-only performance, ITAR/EAR export controls, technical data rights, security requirements, and CUI handling
Coordinate with Contracts and Finance on subcontract changes, invoicing, and program financial reporting

Required Qualifications

8+ years of professional experience in program or technical management of complex technical system development, deployment, and operations
5+ years of hands-on technical experience, preferably in an engineering or similar capacity, or direct ownership of a hardware development effort through design reviews to a tested product
Direct experience with space, defense, or aerospace program planning and execution
Demonstrated experience managing programs with multiple subcontractors and a complex critical-path supply chain
Experience executing rapid-acquisition or prototype agreements for government customers, with familiarity navigating the government program lifecycle, technical data rights, and contract deliverables
Active Secret U.S. security clearance
U.S. citizenship required (Clearance required and program is ITAR-restricted)
Excellent written communication skills; you will author or approve the program's contract deliverables

Preferred Qualifications

Active Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance
Prior experience on a missile warning, missile tracking, missile defense, or similar space-based infrared program
Working knowledge of EO/IR sensor architectures, focal plane arrays, and cryocooler integration
Working knowledge of missile warning data products and techniques for detection and tracking
Experience managing programs through environmental test campaigns (TVAC, vibration, EMI/EMC)
Experience with launch integration and early on-orbit operations

Salary

The salary range for this role is $206,000 - $232,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C.

MDH Behavioral Health Administration, Division of Prevention and Promotion, Baltimore MD

Main Purpose of Job

This position serves as the Program Manager for the Office of Overdose Prevention and Education within the Division of Prevention and Promotion at the Behavioral Health Administration (BHA). As a senior-level manager, this position leads Maryland’s statewide drug user health program infrastructure and oversees the development, implementation, and oversight of programs aimed at reducing substance use-related morbidity and mortality, particularly among people who use drugs.

The Program Manager is responsible for administering Drug User Health Services, which include initiatives such as overdose education and naloxone distribution (OEND), Opioid Associated Disease Prevention and Outreach Programs (OADPOP)s, drug user health training and capacity building, epidemiological surveillance, and systems-level coordination. Additionally, this position oversees efforts to expand access to buprenorphine in community-based settings through the Medication for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD) Intervention Unit, which includes the Hub and Spoke model, Overdose Survivors Outreach Programs, Screening, Brief Intervention, and Referral to Treatment (SBIRT), and Maryland Addiction Consultation Services (MACS).

With a combined budget of approximately $30 million, this position provides strategic and programmatic leadership to ensure drug user health programs are effectively managed, fiscally accountable, and compliant with federal and state guidelines. The Program Manager also represents BHA in multi-agency collaborations, advises senior leadership on policy and funding priorities, and ensures alignment with BHA’s mission to support equity, recovery, and health for all Marylanders impacted by substance use.

This position is eligible for hybrid telework, which is subject to change as necessitated by operations and customer-focused demands.

Minimum Qualifications

Qualified candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university and six years of health or human services administrative or professional experience, including three years at a supervisory or managerial level.

A Master's degree from an accredited college or university will substitute for one year of the general experience and a Doctorate will substitute for two years of the general experience. Additional experience will substitute on a year-for-year basis for the college degree.

Desired Or Preferred Qualifications

Desired candidates should possess the following:

■ Demonstrated knowledge of evidence-based drug user health, overdose prevention, and strategies to reduce substance use-related morbidity and mortality.

■ Experience developing, implementing, and overseeing statewide or large-scale behavioral health, substance use, overdose prevention, or MOUD programs.

■ Experience managing complex state and/or federal grant-funded programs, including programmatic oversight, subgranting, procurement, fiscal accountability, and compliance requirements.

■ Experience supervising managers and multidisciplinary teams, including programmatic, epidemiological, technical, and administrative staff.

■ Experience developing policy, operational protocols, and strategic recommendations related to substance use, overdose prevention, or public health.

■ Experience using epidemiological and programmatic data to inform program implementation, evaluation, resource allocation, and quality improvement.

■ Experience collaborating with state agencies, local jurisdictions, community-based organizations, healthcare partners, and other stakeholders on complex statewide initiatives.

SELECTION PROCESS

This is a Management Service position and serves at the pleasure of the Appointing Authority. A resume must be uploaded to your application.
